text: Paper · arXiv preprint (NeurIPS 2026 style) · arXiv 2608.16072 Learn What's Left, Not What's Mastered: Saturation Aware Advantage Reweighting for Multi-Reward Policy Optimization (SA-MRPO) Yixuan Wang*, Yifei Chen*, Haichao Zhang, Haozheng Luo, Xander Wu, Jie Ni, Yun Fu, Nuno Vasconcelos, Yijiang Li† (* equal contribution; † corresponding author and project lead) University of Florida, UC San Diego, Northeastern University, Northwestern University, Stanford University, Zillion Network, Universität Innsbruck · 17 August 2026 (arXiv v1, the only version) In one line: Drop-in advantage reweighting for multi-reward GRPO/RLVR: normalise each objective per group, then down-weight it by (1 - batch saturation)^γ so the update goes to objectives with headroom left; it beats GDPO (its γ = 0 case) on 12 of 15 math comparisons and by 3.8 points on average in adaptive reasoning, with γ = 0.5 best in the ablation.
